2608.03584.title: Policy Fragmentation or Institutional Alignment? Institutional Governance of AI in Universities and Business Schools
2608.03584.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming high-skilled domains, requiring higher education institutions (HEI) to balance the teaching of foundational principles with the integration of emerging tools to ensure workforce readiness. While HEI are increasingly adopting AI, many continue to grapple with how it should be incorporated into curricula and governed through policy, especially when such policies are set at different levels of an institution. This research analyzes AI policies across HEI from 34 states in the United States to investigate what these policies entail and how policies set across institutions as well as within different levels at an institution differ. Using natural language processing (NLP) to analyze institutional AI policies, we find a clear divergence: university-level policies emphasize data security and risk mitigation whereas school-level policies, when present, focus on pedagogical applications and tool usage. When focusing on business school specific policies, relatively few business schools maintain AI policies distinct from university frameworks, creating misalignment with discipline-specific learning objectives. This gap poses challenges particularly for faculty and students as well as for accreditation purposes. Our insights suggest that guidelines should be aligned with broader institutional policies while addressing discipline-specific learning objectives and evolving workforce demands.
2608.03584.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）正在迅速改變高技能領域，要求高等教育機構（HEI）在教授基礎原則與整合新興工具之間取得平衡，以確保勞動力的準備就緒。儘管HEI越來越多地採用AI，但許多機構仍在努力思考如何將其納入課程以及如何通過政策進行治理，特別是當這些政策在機構的不同層級設定時。這項研究分析了來自美國34個州的HEI的AI政策，以調查這些政策的內容以及跨機構和機構內不同層級設定的政策之間的差異。通過使用自然語言處理（NLP）來分析機構的AI政策，我們發現了一個明顯的分歧：大學層級的政策強調數據安全和風險緩解，而學校層級的政策（如果存在）則專注於教學應用和工具使用。在專注於商學院特定政策時，相對較少的商學院保持與大學框架不同的AI政策，這造成了與學科特定學習目標的不一致。這一差距對於教職員和學生以及認證目的特別構成挑戰。我們的見解表明，指導方針應與更廣泛的機構政策保持一致，同時解決學科特定的學習目標和不斷演變的勞動力需求。
